target.statement: FID score of 58.43 for Cali-Sketch on the CUHK face sketch dataset (Table 1, 'Ours' row, FID column)

compute.basis: Training two GANs (SCN and ISN) from scratch on 256x256 images for many epochs, plus generating four styles of human-like sketches, is a multi-day GPU task; no code is provided so the entire pipeline must be reimplemented.

blockers: No code or pretrained models released
Requires training two GANs from scratch (SCN and ISN) with a three-stage training strategy
Requires generating four different styles of human-like sketches using external methods (XDoG, Photoshop, photo-sketch, FDoG)
Training on CPU is infeasible within a few hours; needs a GPU
title: Cali-Sketch: Stroke Calibration and Completion for High-Quality Face Image Generation from Human-Like Sketches
